solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: In beginning ale sure to be plentiful?

indicators.note: in beginning points to the opening letter of the word ale that follows

parts.note: someone sure to do something is bound to do it

explanation.surface: A question about whether the beer will flow freely at the start of a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link word; the definition is the verb phrase 'be plentiful'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: things that abound exist in great quantity, so they are plentiful.

clue.text: He takes out silly person twice on island (northern)

indicators.note: twice says the silly-person word is written two times in a row

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A fool, doubly so, stranded on a northern island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes out' is slang for kills, so 'He takes out' defines a killer.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to take someone out is to murder them, which is the work of a hired killer.

clue.text: Repaired bootees left inside, no longer used

indicators.note: inside says the left letter is placed within the rearranged letters
repaired suggests the letters of bootees are put back together in a new order

explanation.surface: Baby bootees that have been mended and stored away are no longer worn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Repaired' rearranges BOOTEES into OBSOETE, and 'inside' puts L within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something obsolete has gone out of use, superseded by newer things.

clue.text: Requirement of new English journalist

parts.note: ED, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: What a fresh English reporter must have.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a requirement is something necessary, a thing one must have.

clue.text: A son enters political group in European region

indicators.note: enters says the a-and-son letters go inside the political group

parts.note: a caucus is a group within a political party

explanation.surface: A young man joins a party faction somewhere in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Geography: the mountainous area between the Black and Caspian Seas, partly in Europe.

clue.text: In unprofessional way, email hurt, say — needs rewriting

indicators.note: needs rewriting says the letters of the preceding words must be written out again in a new order

explanation.surface: An email that has caused offence, so to speak, ought to be redrafted.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: done like a novice rather than an expert, hence in an unprofessional manner.

clue.text: College friend rising to applaud

indicators.note: rising in a down entry means the friend word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A college companion stands up to cheer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to applaud is to strike the hands together in approval.

clue.text: Small lake in Berkshire town

parts.note: a lough is an Irish word for a lake

explanation.surface: A little pond in a town in southern England.
explanation.walkthrough: Berkshire is an English county west of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Slough is a large town in Berkshire, near Windsor.

clue.text: Performer has selection of tunes in German

indicators.note: selection of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An entertainer whose repertoire includes some German songs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a vocalist is one kind of performer.

clue.text: Become aware of former county cricket team

parts.note: to suss is to work out or realise, British slang
ex means former

explanation.surface: Realising that a cricket team once belonged to a county that no longer exists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'former' sits by 'county' as if Sussex were a former county; it gives EX. Sussex plays English county cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Sussex is one of the eighteen first-class English county cricket sides.

clue.text: One calorie in reddish-brown biscuit

indicators.note: in says the one and calorie letters go inside the colour word

parts.note: maroon is a brownish-red colour
A means one, as in a single item
C is the abbreviation for calorie

explanation.surface: A single calorie in a nicely browned cookie.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a macaroon is a sweet almond or coconut biscuit.

clue.text: Veto, craven, is represented as averse to change

indicators.note: represented here means presented again, so the letters of the three words are put in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A cowardly veto is portrayed as resistance to reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a conservative person prefers tradition and resists innovation.

clue.text: Part of foot shown by swimmer

definitions.meaning: a flatfish found in the sea

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the underside of the foot, and a flatfish caught for food.

clue.text: Some auto, well dried with this?

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A car that has been washed and wiped down afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Function: a cloth for drying is what you would wipe something dry with.

clue.text: Frightening guy regularly seen in zoo garden

indicators.note: regularly says every other letter of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: A scary man often spotted in the zoo grounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a monstrous, cruel man who terrifies others is called a brute or monster.

clue.text: Feminist good about Queen

parts.note: re means about or concerning
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword Queen

explanation.surface: A women's rights campaigner who is kind about the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Germaine Greer wrote The Female Eunuch, a classic feminist text.

clue.text: Demanding bow? Quite the opposite

definitions.meaning: the bow is the front of a ship; its opposite is the back

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: strict or severe, and the rear of a ship, opposite to its front.

clue.text: Arrest teen, it could result in charge

indicators.note: could result in says the letters of the preceding words might be rearranged to produce something new

explanation.surface: Detaining a youngster might lead to them being charged with a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charge' looks like a criminal charge; it is the cost of borrowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Finance: the percentage a lender levies on a loan is the cost charged for borrowing.

clue.text: Very determined, that man will be knight over time

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece over another comes before it

parts.note: he'll is the short form of he will
taken as written
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A resolute man who will be knighted in due course.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in HE'LL is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: bent on something at any cost, utterly resolved to do it.

clue.text: A wise man defends cold forebear

indicators.note: defends means the wise man surrounds and guards the cold letter

parts.note: Nestor was the wise old counsellor in Homer's Iliad

explanation.surface: A sage protects someone from the chill.
explanation.walkthrough: Nestor is the elderly adviser of the Greeks at Troy.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a forebear is a person from whom one is descended.

clue.text: Poles lodging currency to encourage medical professional

indicators.note: lodging says the two poles house the currency between them

parts.note: N and S are the north and south poles
the euro is a European currency
to urge on is to encourage

explanation.surface: Eastern Europeans depositing money to motivate a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' looks like people from Poland; it is the north and south poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a doctor who operates on the brain and nerves is one kind of medical professional.

clue.text: A group of six in vehicle bringing choice food

indicators.note: in says the a and six pieces sit inside the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Six people in a car delivering a gourmet meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bringing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: sturgeon roe is a luxury delicacy, a prime example of choice food.

clue.text: Judge leaders in conspiracy rigorously in trial in court

indicators.note: leaders in says the opening letter of each following word is taken

explanation.surface: A judge examines a conspiracy closely during a court trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Judge' looks like the court official; it is a reviewer who judges merit.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a reviewer evaluates and passes judgement on works, as a verb or noun sense of judge.

clue.text: First class railway, well-ventilated

parts.note: A1 is first class, with the digit read as the letter I

explanation.surface: A premium train carriage with good fresh air.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a room with plenty of fresh air flowing through it is well-ventilated.

clue.text: Jocular retort entirely accepted by Seychelles girl

indicators.note: accepted by says the entirely word is taken inside the Seychelles letters

parts.note: SY is the international vehicle code for the Seychelles
all means entirely, as in all alone

explanation.surface: A girl from the Seychelles takes a witty comeback in her stride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'girl' adds a second definition: Sally is a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a sally is a witty or lively remark, a quip.

clue.text: Great delight in government shelter

parts.note: lee is shelter from the wind

explanation.surface: Joy at being housed by the state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: glee is great joy or delight.

clue.text: Fruit — two, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word for two is spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: a pair is two

explanation.surface: Someone thinks they heard a couple of fruits mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the pear is a common orchard fruit.

clue.text: Lady from Chennai on the rise

indicators.note: on the rise in a down entry means the letters read upwards
from says the letters are taken out of the middle of the city name

explanation.surface: A woman from an Indian city who is climbing the social ladder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' extracts ENNA from Chennai, and 'on the rise' turns it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Anne is a woman's name, so a lady.

clue.text: Adventurous favourite, forward about credentials

parts.note: in means popular or favoured

indicators.note: about says the forward word is turned round

parts.note: pert means cheeky or forward
ID is identification, one's credentials

explanation.surface: A pushy favourite showing their papers, keen for adventure.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an intrepid person is fearless and bold, ready for adventure.

clue.text: Maybe fly home with minority group

parts.note: in means at home
a sect is a small religious faction

explanation.surface: Perhaps a member of a small faction will escape home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe fly' looks like a verb; 'fly' is the noun, an example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a fly is one kind of six-legged creature, hence 'maybe'.

clue.text: Soldiers (a hundred) arrange to get musical instrument

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers
C is a hundred in Roman numerals
to order is to arrange

explanation.surface: A hundred troops organise to obtain a band instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the recorder is a simple woodwind played by schoolchildren.

clue.text: One examining, irritable finishing early at sign of hesitation

indicators.note: finishing early means the irritable word loses its final letter

parts.note: testy means irritable
er is a sound made when hesitating

explanation.surface: A grumpy examiner who keeps hesitating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who examines or tries things out is a checker or examiner.
